data.one_liner: Zero-dependency cached network image widget with shimmer, retry, and profile initials
data.what_it_does: Provides a Flutter widget that loads images from the network, caches them on disk, and displays a shimmer or spinner while loading. It handles errors, retries, and can show profile initials when the image is missing.
use_when: You need a lightweight image loader without external dependencies
You want built‑in caching and offline support
You need a shimmer placeholder or retry button
You want to display profile initials when an image fails
avoid_when: You already use cached_network_image or shimmer
You need advanced image manipulation or decoding
You require a custom HTTP client beyond the built‑in one
strengths: Built‑in disk cache with ETag/Last‑Modified support
weaknesses: No support for advanced image formats like SVG or vector graphics
No direct integration with image picking or editing
Limited to network images only (no local assets)
No built‑in support for image transformations (crop, resize)
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec and import package

alternatives.name: cached_network_image
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides similar caching but with external dependencies and less control over shimmer

alternatives.name: octo_image
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers advanced caching and placeholder options but depends on cached_network_image

CustomCachedImage(
